company_excerpt:
Firefox: The fast, private browser that keeps you safe

Find your way back to a better internet

The web was meant to expand your world, not limit it. Firefox helps you shape a more personal internet that puts you back in control.

PRIVACY


Privacy as a standard

Blocks trackers automatically. No setup. No guesswork.

FOCUS


Focus without distraction

Stay focused with tab groups, reader mode, and videos that stay in view.

CHOICE


Control and choice built in

Customize how AI shows up, or turn it off entirely.

Independence


Not owned by shareholders

We don’t sell your personal data and we never will.


Fast to switch. Easy to settle in.

When switching to Firefox, your bookmarks, passwords, and history come with you automatically, so you can get back to browsing right away.

 1. Select what you want to bring with you
 2. Download Firefox
 3. Click import


Fast to switch. Easy to settle in.

When switching to Firefox, your bookmarks, passwords, and history come with you automatically, so you can get back to browsing right away.

 1. Over 30,000 extensions
 2. Thousands of light & dark mode themes
 3. Edit PDFs directly in Firefox


Privacy without the work


All your stuff on desktop, mobile, and tablet


Built to benefit billions, not billionaires


Stay focused without distractions

Firefox is designed to work with your attention, not compete for it. Reader mode clears distractions from articles, picture-in-picture keeps video out of your way, and pinned tabs keep what matters close without clutter.

rival_sources.title: Privacy Protection & Security Features | Brave
rival_sources.excerpt: And it comes in three different layers. The first layer—Brave Shields—blocks trackers, cross-site cookie tracking, fingerprinting, and more. And you can see some of what got blocked.

rival_sources.title: Brave Browser Features | Brave
rival_sources.excerpt: Learn more about fingerprint randomization. Brave hides or blocks cookie consent notices while you browse. ... Get a firsthand look at the ads and trackers blocked by Shields. Learn more about the Privacy Hub.

rival_sources.title: Privacy updates | Brave
rival_sources.excerpt: Starting in version 1.50, Brave will include a new feature called “HTTPS by Default” that improves Web security and privacy by increasing HTTPS use. ... New versions of Brave will hide—and, where possible, completely block—cookie consent ...

rival_sources.title: The guide to Brave browser privacy and security features
rival_sources.excerpt: Brave incorporates many of the industry's best practices for privacy and security features and adds a lot more on top of that: navigation-based tracking, farbling, and a built-in VPN.

rival_sources.title: Browser Privacy Policy | Brave
rival_sources.excerpt: The Brave browser is designed to not know who you are, or what sites you visit. Brave does not collect or retain a user’s browsing history. Some features require transient network identifiers (such as your IP addresses) to function.
